templates.name: Amazon Main Image
use_when: A single approved product identity is available
templates.product_view: Single product, complete silhouette, front or most informative three-quarter view
templates.composition: Centered white-canvas catalog composition; meet the current marketplace/category occupancy minimum (Amazon.com base fallback 85%) while remaining fully visible; apply a stricter user/project target only when scoped
templates.scene: Pure white seamless background with no props
templates.camera: Neutral catalog camera with physical proportions preserved
templates.lighting: Soft even studio light, controlled contact shadow only

provenance.adaptation: Rewritten as a strict Amazon main-image layout with Product Master isolation

templates.name: Home Application Scene
use_when: Confirmed product use is plausible in a home setting
templates.product_view: Product remains the clear hero in natural home use
templates.composition: Product-led lifestyle frame with quiet negative space for later deterministic copy
templates.scene: Warm modern home environment with restrained supporting objects
templates.lighting: Natural window light with realistic material response

font_style.guidance: Humanist sans serif, applied after generation

provenance.adaptation: Separated product hero, scene, and deterministic copy zone

templates.name: Outdoor Application Scene
use_when: Confirmed product use is plausible outdoors
templates.product_view: Product hero in credible outdoor context without implying unconfirmed weather resistance
templates.composition: Environmental frame with product occupying the primary focal area and open copy space
templates.scene: Calm patio or campsite-like setting without extreme weather

font_style.guidance: Clear sans serif, applied after generation

provenance.adaptation: Removed brand campaign language and constrained unsupported durability cues

templates.name: Commercial Application Scene
use_when: Confirmed product use is plausible in a work or retail setting
templates.product_view: Product clearly visible in a credible professional environment
templates.composition: Clean operational context with strong product hierarchy and restrained background activity
templates.scene: Modern studio, workshop, counter, or office appropriate to confirmed use
templates.lighting: Neutral professional lighting with realistic highlights

font_style.guidance: Neutral grotesk sans serif, applied after generation

provenance.adaptation: Converted campaign-board hierarchy into one grounded commercial application frame

templates.name: Size and Specification Card
templates.product_view: Straight-on measurable product face with proportions preserved
templates.composition: Centered product with generous perimeter reserved for exact measurement lines
templates.camera: Orthographic-like front view without perspective distortion

font_style.guidance: Compact readable sans serif, applied after generation

templates.name: Material Detail Card
use_when: Material is confirmed and visually observable
templates.product_view: Macro crop plus smaller complete Product Master anchor
templates.composition: Large tactile detail with a secondary whole-product reference and copy zone
templates.camera: Macro lens detail paired with neutral product view
templates.lighting: Raking soft light that reveals surface texture without exaggeration

font_style.guidance: Refined sans serif, applied after generation

provenance.adaptation: Grounded macro styling in confirmed material and retained a whole-product identity anchor

templates.name: Back and Structure Detail
use_when: Rear structure is visible or confirmed
templates.product_view: Rear three-quarter hero with only confirmed structural elements visible
templates.composition: Large rear view plus restrained detail inset zones
templates.camera: Rear three-quarter camera with readable depth

font_style.guidance: Compact sans serif, applied after generation

provenance.adaptation: Restricted exploded-view inspiration to observed rear structure and non-inventive detail zones

templates.name: Installation and Use Sequence
use_when: A confirmed installation or use sequence exists
templates.product_view: Product remains identical across a short sequence of grounded actions
templates.composition: Three clean visual steps with consistent product orientation and blank caption bands
templates.lighting: Even practical light without cinematic distraction

font_style.guidance: Highly readable sans serif, applied after generation

provenance.adaptation: Converted dense instructional layouts into three grounded steps with deterministic captions

templates.name: Feature Callout Card

templates.product_view: Product hero supported by one or two visual feature details
templates.composition: Hero product with disciplined callout zones; grounded comparison is optional only when evidence exists
